{{Quote|Rys. Always focused on the enemy are you. For inspiration, look to yourself and those beside you.|[[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to Rys|audio=YodaRys.flac|<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>}}
'''Rys''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], under [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Thire/Legends|Thire]], as part of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]]. At the start of the war he was part of the [[Diplomatic Escort Group]], but he desired to be on the frontline. His time came when he and a [[Jek/Legends|fellow trooper]] accompanied [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on his [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|Mission to Rugosa]]. He could be distinguished from his fellow clones by a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on his neck and jaw.

==Biography==
[[File:Rys-TCW.png|thumb|left|180px|Rys in full armor sans helmet]]
Early in the war in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Rys was posted on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he usually served as a diplomatic escort or for the protection of the Senate district. Though he was as loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as any of his brethren, Rys was disappointed by this assignment and was eager to join his brothers on the remote battlefronts. When off-duty, he would, as a hobby, track the movement of Republic fleet assets and follow the course of the war as it unfolded in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

Rys got his chance to see the real action when he and trooper [[Jek/Legends|Jek]], under the command of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Thire/Legends|Thire]], were assigned to escort [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on a diplomatic mission to the coral moon of [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]]. When their transport was ambushed by Separatist frigates, Yoda and the troopers landed on the moon's surface in the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. The clones helped Yoda to get past a whole battalion of [[T81 Division]]'s [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] along with [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], sent by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to intercept them as a challenge to the competency of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the Republic's forces, in order to secure a treaty with [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]]. During the mission, Yoda advised Rys not to focus upon his enemies, but instead to take inspiration from himself and his allies. It was an important lesson that Rys took to heart, which helped him to successfully complete the mission.
